run_collect_env_main: run the collect_env script to print full environment info including platform, Python, GCC, CMake, and GPU details
run_command_shell: run a shell command via run_command and return its stripped stdout output as a string
get_gcc_version: get the installed GCC compiler version string by running gcc --version
get_nvidia_smi: get NVIDIA GPU information by running nvidia-smi and filtering empty trailing lines
get_pip_packages: get pip package versions filtered against requirements.txt using a join and sort pipeline
